note: The spoken lines of the hẻm (plan 0003, R1). A line with a speaker is speech: "vi" is the subtitle, "en" is the meaning in the Listen app, and "say" (optional) is the text that the voice reads. A line without a speaker is a description for the Lens app ("text"). "replies" are the phrasebook answers, "actions" are the answers by an action in the world, and "then" is the next line of the same talk.

say_again.vi: Dạ, {address} nói lại được không ạ?
say_again.en: Could you say that again, please?

batu.intro.speaker: batu
batu.intro.vi: Bà là bà Tư đó con.

batu.greet.speaker: batu
batu.greet.vi: Ủa, con dậy rồi hả? Ăn sáng chưa con?
batu.greet.en: Oh, you're up? Have you had breakfast yet, dear?

batu.reply_chua.speaker: batu
batu.reply_chua.vi: Chưa hả? Đi qua Cô Sáu ăn tô phở đi, kẻo hết!
batu.reply_chua.en: Not yet? Go have a bowl of phở at Cô Sáu's, before it runs out!

batu.reply_chua_said.speaker: batu
batu.reply_chua_said.vi: Trời, con nói tiếng Việt giỏi quá! Qua Cô Sáu ăn tô phở đi con, kẻo hết.
batu.reply_chua_said.en: My, your Vietnamese is so good! Go have a bowl of phở at Cô Sáu's, dear, before it runs out.

batu.reply_english.speaker: batu
batu.reply_english.vi: Good morning! Phở, phở! Cô Sáu.
batu.reply_english.en: Good morning! Phở! Go to Cô Sáu's.

batu.call_after.speaker: batu
batu.call_after.vi: Đi đâu đó con? Nhớ ăn sáng nghen!
batu.call_after.en: Where are you off to, dear? Remember to eat breakfast!

cosau.intro.speaker: cosau
cosau.intro.vi: Cô là Cô Sáu, bán phở ở đây nè.
cosau.intro.en: I'm Cô Sáu. I sell phở here.

cosau.closed_before.speaker: cosau
cosau.closed_before.vi: Chưa mở con ơi, chút nữa nghen.
cosau.closed_before.en: Not open yet, dear. A little later, okay?

cosau.wait.speaker: cosau
cosau.wait.vi: Ừ, năm giờ rưỡi mở nghen.
cosau.wait.en: Mm, we open at half past five.

cosau.thanks_said.speaker: cosau
cosau.thanks_said.vi: Trời ơi, dễ thương quá! Ngồi đi con.
cosau.thanks_said.en: Oh my, how sweet! Sit down, dear.

cosau.english.speaker: cosau
cosau.english.vi: Ô kê, ô kê! Ngồi, ngồi!

cosau.sold_out.speaker: cosau
cosau.sold_out.vi: Hết rồi con ơi! Sáng mai đi sớm sớm nghen.
cosau.sold_out.en: It's all gone, dear! Come early tomorrow morning, okay?

cosau.call_after.speaker: cosau
cosau.call_after.en: Oh, where are you going, dear?

bacha.intro.speaker: bacha
bacha.intro.vi: Bác là bác Hà, bác nấu phở Bắc.
bacha.intro.en: I'm Bác Hà. I cook Northern phở.

bacha.open.speaker: bacha
bacha.open.en: Please come in and have some phở!

cout.intro.speaker: cout
cout.intro.vi: Bánh khọt Cô Út đây anh!
cout.intro.en: This is Cô Út's bánh khọt!

cout.call.speaker: cout
cout.call.vi: Bánh khọt nè! Ăn thử đi anh!

nga.hello.speaker: nga
nga.hello.vi: Con đi chơi vui không? Có gì cứ nhắn cô nghen.
nga.hello.en: Are you having fun? If you need anything, just send me a message.

nga.glad_said.speaker: nga
nga.glad_said.vi: Ui, con nói giỏi ghê! Cô mừng lắm.
nga.glad_said.en: Oh, you speak so well! I'm so glad.

nga.english.speaker: nga
nga.english.vi: Good, good! Đi chơi vui nghen con.
nga.english.en: Good, good! Have fun out there, dear.

coc.talk.1.speaker: chubay
coc.talk.1.vi: Tối qua coi đá banh chưa? Đá dở quá trời!
coc.talk.1.en: Did you watch the football last night? They played so badly!

coc.talk.2.speaker: chuchin
coc.talk.2.vi: Dở gì mà dở! Thua có một trái thôi mà.
coc.talk.2.en: Badly? Come on! They only lost by one goal.

coc.talk.3.speaker: chubay
coc.talk.3.vi: Một trái cũng là thua! Uống ly nữa không?
coc.talk.3.en: One goal is still a loss! Another glass?

coc.talk.4.speaker: chuchin
coc.talk.4.vi: Thôi, một ly đủ rồi. Ngồi chơi chút nữa.
coc.talk.4.en: No, one glass is enough. Let's sit a little longer.

coc.sea.1.speaker: chuchin
coc.sea.1.vi: Sáng nay biển êm ghê, ghe về sớm.
coc.sea.1.en: The sea is calm this morning. The boats came back early.

coc.sea.2.speaker: chubay
coc.sea.2.vi: Ừ, nghe nói cá thu nhiều lắm.
coc.sea.2.en: Yeah, I hear there's a lot of mackerel.

coc.sea.3.speaker: chuchin
coc.sea.3.vi: Chiều ra chợ mua một con về kho.
coc.sea.3.en: This afternoon I'll buy one at the market and braise it.

coc.kid.1.speaker: chubay
coc.kid.1.vi: Thằng cháu tui mới đậu đại học rồi đó.
coc.kid.1.en: My grandson just got into university.

coc.kid.2.speaker: chuchin
coc.kid.2.vi: Vậy hả? Giỏi quá! Phải đãi cà phê đi chớ.
coc.kid.2.en: Really? Great! Then you have to buy me a coffee.

spot.home.look.text: Bà Tư's homestay. Your room upstairs has a fan and a window over the hẻm. From the kitchen comes the smell of nước mắm and something frying.

spot.pho.closed_before.text: The shutter is half up. Cô Sáu is tending the pot.

spot.pho.open.text: Steam rises from the big pot. Cô Sáu waves people to the low tables.

spot.pho.sold_out.text: Cô Sáu is washing the last bowls. The pot is empty.

spot.pho.closed_after.text: The shutter is down. Cô Sáu sells phở in the morning only, from {open} until it runs out.

spot.banhmi.look.text: Warm loaves stacked behind glass. A line of people in work clothes and school uniforms.

spot.coc.look.text: Plastic stools along the wall, glasses with a phin dripping on top. Two men argue about football. Nobody is in a hurry.

spot.coc.closed.text: The stools are stacked against the wall. Coffee starts again at {open}.

spot.bac.look.text: Bác Hà speaks with a Northern accent. On her table: chili, lime, and garlic vinegar. No bean sprouts. No hoisin.

spot.bac.closed.text: Shutter down. Bác Hà sells in the morning only.

spot.mia.look.text: The press squeaks. Cane goes in, green-gold juice comes out over ice, with a squeeze of tắc.

spot.banhkhot.look.text: Cô Út pours rice batter into a hot mold full of little cups, drops a shrimp in each, and covers it. They come out crispy and yellow, one bite each. At the table: lettuce, herbs, and a bowl of nước mắm.

spot.banhkhot.closed.text: Shutter down. Cô Út starts the fire at {open} in the morning.

spot.hvl.look.text: A basket of warm duck eggs under a cloth. A man cracks the top of one, sips the broth, adds salt and pepper, and eats it with rau răm. Next to him, a girl orders hers fried in tamarind sauce.

spot.go.look.text: The helper clacks two bamboo sticks as he walks: lóc cóc, lóc cóc. Call out from your door, and the bowl comes to you.

spot.beach.dawn.text: The boats are in. Fish are sorted on the sand, and neighbors buy them right there. Behind them, people jog, stretch, and swing their arms before the sun gets hot.

spot.beach.day.text: The sun is hot. The sand is almost empty, and the boats wait out at sea.

spot.beach.evening.text: The heat breaks. Families sit on mats, kids run at the water, and scooters roll along the coast road.

spot.beach.night.text: Dark water and the sound of waves. Far out, the lights of fishing boats.
